chapter.v:
Praise Yah!Praise
Yahweh from the heavens!Praise him in the heights!

Praise him,
all his angels!Praise him, all his army!

Praise him,
sun and moon!Praise him, all you shining stars!

Praise him,
you heavens of heavens,you waters that are above the heavens.

Let them
praise Yahweh’s name,for he commanded, and they were created.

He has
also established them forever and ever.He has made a decree which will not pass away.

Praise Yahweh
from the earth,you great sea creatures, and all depths,

lightning and
hail, snow and clouds,stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

mountains and
all hills,fruit trees and all cedars,

wild animals
and all livestock,small creatures and flying birds,

kings of
the earth and all peoples,princes and all judges of the earth,

both young
men and maidens,old men and children.

Let them
praise Yahweh’s name,for his name alone is exalted.His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

He has
lifted up the horn of his people,the praise of all his saints,even of the children of Israel, a people near to him.Praise Yah!
